releaseName: Kisan Mausam v1.7.0 - Direct In-App Update Installer, El Niño (ENSO) & Multi-SIM SMS Edition
changelog:
• Direct In-App Update & Package Installer: Download and install app updates directly inside KisanMausam with live MB/percentage progress bar—no browser redirection required
• Restored El Niño / La Niña (ENSO) Prediction Card on Home screen below weather warning bars with live ONI gauge meter & seasonal probabilities
• Multi-SIM Weather Hazard & SOS Emergency SMS delivery with automatic SIM number detection and high-priority system notifications
